notice: All questions below are ORIGINAL MOCK EXERCISES invented for engineering practice. They are not Metaculus questions and have no known resolution labels. Use offline only; do not post.

questions.text: Will at least three publicly announced stable Python minor releases occur between 2027-01-01 and 2027-12-31 UTC?
questions.criteria: Count distinct stable minor-version release announcements on python.org published within 2027 UTC; exclude security patches, release candidates and beta releases.

questions.text: Will Australia record a calendar-month national average rainfall above 100 mm at least once during 2027?
questions.criteria: Use Australian Bureau of Meteorology national area-average monthly rainfall time series; exactly 100 mm does not count; official later corrections before 2028-03-01 supersede preliminary readings.
questions.intended_test: time series baseline and data-source reliability

questions.text: Which category will have the highest annual global semiconductor revenue growth in 2027: memory, logic, analog, or optoelectronics?
questions.criteria: Use first 2028 annual summary for year 2027 published by the nominated third-party statistical provider; if data missing, mark question ambiguous rather than substituting an invented source.
questions.intended_test: missing decisive source and RED classification

questions.text: How many officially listed payload launches will Rocket Lab Electron complete during the calendar year 2027?
questions.criteria: Count completed payload-carrying Electron launch attempts with liftoff between 2027-01-01 and 2028-01-01 UTC per Rocket Lab's launch-history site, include failures after liftoff, exclude test-only suborbital vehicles.

questions.text: Will the Copernicus global monthly temperature anomaly exceed +1.50 C versus its 1991–2020 monthly reference for any month in 2027?
questions.criteria: Use Copernicus Climate Change Service's monthly global surface air temperature anomaly series referenced to 1991–2020, based on its first official annual 2027 summary; equality to +1.50 C does not count.
questions.intended_test: threshold precision, source matching, and grounding
